narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: Tells the story of Jonas briskly, including every speech introduction and aside.

jonas.name: Jonas
jonas.note: The reluctant prophet, son of Amathi; resigned in the storm, fervent in prayer, sullen and angry at Ninive's pardon.

1.t: Now the Lord prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah: and Jonah was in the belly of a fish for three days and three nights.

2.t: And Jonah prayed to the Lord, his God, out of the belly of the fish.

3.t: I cried out of my affliction to the Lord, and he heard me: I cried out of the belly of hell, and thou hast heard my voice.

4.t: And thou hast cast me forth into the deep, in the heart of the sea, and a flood hast compassed me: all thy billows, and thy waves have passed over me.

5.t: And I said: I am cast away out of the sight of thy eyes: but yet I shall see the holy temple again.

6.t: The waters compassed me about even to the soul: the deep hath closed me round about, the sea hath covered my head.

7.t: I went down to the lowest parts of the mountains: the bars of the earth have shut me up for ever: and thou wilt bring up my life from corruption, O Lord, my God.

8.t: When my soul was in distress within me, I remembered the Lord: that my prayer may come to thee, unto the holy temple.

9.t: They that in vain observe vanities, forsake their own mercy.

10.t: But I with the voice of praise will sacrifice to thee: I will pay whatsoever I have vowed for my salvation to the Lord.

11.t: And the Lord spoke to the fish: and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
